verdict.rationale: The reviewer's concern is valid: nothing in the pack mentions GPU, OpenGL, or any hardware-accelerated rendering method, so a full verdict is not supported. The performance half of the story is well evidenced. The GitHub README says Alacritty consistently scores better than the competition on vtebench throughput. Hands-on reports back this up: a heavy `find` finished in 0:20 versus 1:28 in iTerm2, capping refresh at the screen rate keeps it responsive when catting a 1GB file, and it avoids the hangs kitty hit on garbled binary output. Missing for 10: any first-party or independent evidence that rendering is GPU-accelerated, and recent independent benchmarks (one user finds foot faster).
